data.title: 樱花坡道下的回眸约定
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, nene_school_uniform, navy blazer, yellow bowtie, grey plaid pleated skirt, black thighhighs, leather loafers, holding school bag, looking back, outstretched hand, gentle smile, blush, floating hair, cherry blossoms, falling petals, foreground petals, stone slope, sunlit sky, dappled sunlight, backlit hair, from below, cowboy shot
data.animaCaption: Pausing two steps ahead on the cherry-lined slope, she turns back with her school bag tucked behind her and extends one open hand toward you. Backlit spring sunlight turns the drifting petals and her fluttering silver hair translucent.
data.promptProse: Framed from a slight low angle along a sun-drenched stone slope beneath arching cherry trees, Ayachi Nene pauses ahead and pivots back toward the viewer. Wearing her navy school blazer, yellow bowtie, grey plaid pleated skirt, and black thighhighs, she holds her leather school bag behind her hip with one hand while offering her other hand forward in an unhurried invitation. Soft pink petals drift across the near foreground and through her wind-lifted silver twin tails, with bright afternoon backlighting edging her blazer shoulders and casting dappled petal shadows across the steps.
data.story: 春风卷起整条坡道的樱花瓣。走在前面的宁宁忽然停住脚步，背着书包回过身朝你伸出手，阳光把她微红的耳尖和银白发梢照得近乎透明——「说好了哦，明年樱花再开的时候，也要一起走这条路。」
